items.text: Intake server update awaiting upload — the Reverse key: reversing a paid order (Orders board, owner only) closes the project down — pack link revoked, the customer's open help threads resolved — and prepares a refund of the exact amount paid, owed to the exact wallet that paid, for your signature on a one-time refund page. The refund settles only when it verifies on-chain; then the order reads REFUNDED and a credit note lands in the books. Files: server/src/server.js, server/src/store.js, server/src/payments.js, server/src/notify.js, server/src/pack.js, server/src/refund.js (new), server/tests/reverse.test.js. The Orders board already carries the button and the refund block.

Intake server update awaiting upload — Helper access: a second, limited Helper Key (HELPER_SECRET — the value is yours to set on Railway) opens the day-to-day boards in Dev Studio Creator, with the owner-only surface refused server-side and helper work recorded as the helper's. Files: server/src/server.js, server/src/store.js, server/src/notify.js, server/tests/helper.test.js. The app already renders both roles; helper keys simply won't open it until this lands.

Intake server update awaiting upload — Dev Studio Creator Tools board: the one-tap tool kinds (build / deploy / test_run / screenshot) with validated payloads (server/src/server.js, server/src/store.js, server/tests/console.test.js). Until it lands, every Tools button still records its ask through the 🙋 request lane — nothing is lost; the structured kinds just switch on at upload.

Intake server update awaiting upload — Website Help full conversation history: threads keep every message (yours + the customer's, in order) instead of one reply, and customers can add follow-ups to their own thread — even re-opening a resolved one. Files: server/src/store.js, server/src/server.js, server/src/help.js, server/tests/help.test.js. The app and website already handle both shapes, so everything reads correctly before and after the upload.
G-1 fix: add the missing 'validator' build key to the intake validator (validate.js) so Validator Launch Kit orders validate instead of being refused.
Open price decision: the Full Intensity Pack — $50 proposed, waiting on your yes.
Launch day: deploy the generators service and set its PUBLIC_BASE_URL.
Launch day: deploy the Token Factory closed; you paste FACTORY_MNEMONIC / STUDIO_WALLET / FEE_ULUNA yourself, then FACTORY_OPEN=true and FACTORY_INTAKE_SETTLE=true.
Launch day: run the intake via automated.js with FULFILLMENT_OPEN=true to arm fulfillment. Flipping it back is the one-switch halt.
Launch day: USTC and any extra payment options stay closed until launch — LUNC is the working rail until then.
Validator Launch Kit card: the 17 non-English overlays still say 'your own server' — the translation pass is your call.
